init.title: Settings
init.description: Configure Speech API and correction pipeline settings.

data_description.api_modes: Select which Azure Speech APIs to use. Fast Transcription supports most locales and phrase hints for improved accuracy. Real-time has lower latency and supports locales not available in Fast Transcription (e.g., Cantonese, Taiwanese Mandarin). When both are selected, Fast Transcription is preferred with automatic fallback.
data_description.correction_stages: Select which correction stages to apply after speech recognition. Deselect all to use Azure's raw transcription directly.

data_description.auto_collect_sources: Automatically collect names from Home Assistant registries. Used by Pre-recognition Hints (API phrase hints) and Similarity Matching (post-recognition correction).

data_description.custom_phrases: Add extra domain-specific words or phrases to improve recognition accuracy.

data_description.custom_replacements: Format: wrong=correct. Applied after speech recognition, before similarity matching.

data_description.fuzzy_threshold: Minimum similarity score (0.5–1.0) required to auto-correct. Lower = more aggressive, higher = more conservative. Default: 0.80.
data_description.custom_exclusions: Words or segments that should never be corrected. Use when a correct word is being incorrectly replaced.
